rule: Make the invite page look like this: Hey, can you make our invite page look like this one I found? Plain off-white page with a solid dark green bar across the top holding our shop name in bold white, then a big bold heading underneath. Below that, one white box with a thin green border, and inside it the reward amount in huge bold red with a small line of text above and below it. Then a short numbered list of three steps, and a full-width red button at the bottom with white text, everything in a classic serif font except the button.
